```python
def information_bottleneck_loss(logits, target_rate=0.8):
    p = torch.sigmoid(logits)           # [B, T] 每 token 保留概率
    mean_p = p.mean(dim=-1)             # [B] 每 sample 平均保留率
    q = target_rate
    kl = mean_p * torch.log(mean_p / q) + (1 - mean_p) * torch.log((1 - mean_p) / (1 - q))
    return kl.mean()
```

先读当前代码：

将 per-token KL 替换为 aggregate rate KL：
```python
def information_bottleneck_loss(logits, target_rate=0.8):
    p = torch.sigmoid(logits)           # [B, T] 每 token 保留概率
    mean_p = p.mean(dim=-1)             # [B] 每 sample 平均保留率
    q = target_rate
    kl = mean_p * torch.log(mean_p / q) + (1 - mean_p) * torch.log((1 - mean_p) / (1 - q))
    return kl.mean()
```

```python
def information_bottleneck_loss(logits, target_rate=0.8):
    """Aggregate rate KL: constrain average retention rate, allow per-token differentiation.
    
    Args:
        logits: [B, T] scorer raw logits
        target_rate: target average retention probability (default 0.8)
    Returns:
        scalar KL divergence between mean retention rate and target_rate
    """
    p = torch.sigmoid(logits)           # [B, T] per-token retention probability
    mean_p = p.mean(dim=-1)             # [B] per-sample average retention rate
    q = target_rate
    # KL(Bernoulli(mean_p) || Bernoulli(q))
    # Add small epsilon for numerical stability
    eps = 1e-8
    mean_p = mean_p.clamp(eps, 1 - eps)
    kl = mean_p * torch.log(mean_p / q) + (1 - mean_p) * torch.log((1 - mean_p) / (1 - q))
    return kl.mean()
```
